_note: Name-facts for Mali (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region

en: The name is often read as "crocodile river" in Bambara, and three crocodiles are on its arms.
it: Il nome si legge spesso come "fiume del coccodrillo" in bambara, e sul suo stemma ci sono tre coccodrilli.
